author: 3rategy
body:
Elysian Classes. Summoners are overpowered as hell. Equipment is solely for survival, your dps is all done by summons. Do memory hunts with equipment and items that boost orn drops to get orns fast and buy the attuner class if you don't have it yet. Explorers waystones you buy from the shops and grand market are very helpful for hunts. 

Focus on high survivability equipment and ward. Get the yeti overcoat if you can. Otherwise just wear whatever gives you the most defense and resistance. Get a good shield or scroll for extra ward in your off hand. 

Hydra staff helps with extra summon stats if you want, but it's not necessary, staff if preference will do but the extra 7% is nice. You can find Hydra in dungeons, most commonly in dragon roost. 

Ward of Mythril (You will likely get one shot if you don't cast this first), Golem Fortitude, Barrier 2, Gait of hildr are the defensive buffs you want, in order from best to least good, and I recommend casting them in succession. Bard specialization for appease is helpful too. Exploit and Threaten helps with making raid bosses easier to deal with if you have the spell space.

The base summons that come with the class are good, but see if you can buy some from the monumental guild shop. Buggane is literally game breaking at T8. 

Fight usually goes like this: Ward, summon to fill field, buff defense, debuff enemy (optional, they're probably dead by the time youre done buffing), replenish summons when depleted. If your ward breaks before your field is up, you're most likely batting above your weight class. But even then, as long as the enemy targets your summons instead of you, you have a chance to be greedy on the next try. Once you've set up your summons and your personal buffs it's very hard to die unless you try to or get solo ulted. Just keep your ward and summons topped off and enjoy the sweep. 

Happy Hunting!
